title: Sr. Project Manager
jobDescription:
Responsibilities Project Leadership : Manage comprehensive project lifecycle activities, including planning, execution, monitoring, and closure, ensuring delivery is on time and within scope and budget. Team Leadership : Guide and mentor a team of project managers, coordinators, and cross-functional professionals. Set goals, monitor team performance, and encourage professional development. Stakeholder Management : Build and maintain effective communication with internal and external stakeholders, including executives, clients, and vendors. Manage expectations and resolve conflicts efficiently. Strategic Planning : Align projects with organizational objectives by defining priorities, managing resources, and promoting continuous improvement strategies in project processes. Cross-Team Collaboration : Work across multiple functions, organizations, and reporting boundaries to align priorities, break silos, and ensure seamless coordination. Foster positive relationships across teams to achieve shared goals effectively and efficiently. PMO Methodology Development : Lead the development and implementation of a scalable Project Management Office (PMO) methodology that can be utilized across all business units. Ensure processes, tools, and templates are standardized yet adaptable to the unique needs of different teams. Risk Management : Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks proactively, ensuring minimal impact on project outcomes while maintaining compliance with governance standards. Quality Assurance : Ensure all project deliverables meet quality standards, organizational guidelines, and client expectations. Actively review project milestones and handle corrective actions as needed. Empathetic Leadership : Exhibit highly tuned emotional intelligence with a deep-seated empathy for the needs of teams and partners. Act as a good listener, provide team support, and champion collaboration and inclusivity in all aspects of project management. Execution Excellence : Maintain relentless focus on driving execution and delivering measurable outcomes. Ensure accountability at all levels and follow through to see projects achieve their intended results. PMP Expertise : Apply deep knowledge of PMI’s PMBOK, incorporating industry-leading project management frameworks and processes into team practices. Qualifications

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field. Experience : Minimum 10+ years of experience managing complex projects and programs across diverse industries; 5+ years of proven experience as a team lead managing cross-functional project teams. Certifications : Active Project Management Professional (PMP®) certification (mandatory). Additional certifications such as PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP®), Pg MP®, or Lean Six Sigma are a plus. Initiative and Accountability : Demonstrated ability to take initiative, anticipate potential setbacks, and apply proactive problem-solving to keep projects on track. A results-driven mindset balanced with the ability to maintain strong partnerships and team morale. Leadership Skills : Demonstrated ability to lead project teams with strong motivational, communication, and conflict resolution skills. Technical Proficiency : Experience with project management tools (e.g., MS Project, JIRA, SAP) and advanced proficiency in MS Excel and data visualization platforms. Experience with Cora nice to have. Collaboration & Communication : Exceptional cross-team collaboration skills with the ability to align priorities and plans across different functions, organizations, and reporting structures. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills are essential. Soft Skills : Strong problem-solving abilities, effective decision-making under pressure, and the ability to cultivate trust and engagement within teams. Apply now Information Technology-615000 Chennai, India Share on: Apply now Terms of service Privacy Cookies Powered by Rippling

title: Storage Engineer L3
jobDescription: Job Description: Storage Engineer (SAN) – Level 3 Experience Level: Senior Role Type: Storage, SAN & Data Protection Engineering Depart... Job Description: Storage Engineer (SAN) – Level 3 Experience Level: Senior Role Type: Storage, SAN & Data Protection Engineering Department: Infrastructure & Cloud Operations Overview We are seeking a highly experienced Storage Engineer (SAN) – Level 3 with strong expertise in enterprise storage arrays, SAN fabric operations, cloud storage platforms (AWS & Azure), and Level 2 proficiency in Commvault Data Protection . The role involves supporting large-scale hybrid storage environments, ensuring performance, data protection, and operational excellence. Key Responsibilities Storage Management (On-Prem) Lead administration of multi-vendor enterprise storage: Hitachi VSP/HCP Net App HPE Nimble/Primera/3PAR/MSA Dell EMC Synology NAS LUN provisioning, RAID/pool configuration, replication, snapshots, and performance tuning. Perform storage migrations, lifecycle upgrades, and expansion planning. Cloud Storage Administration (AWS & Azure) AWS Cloud Storage Skills Manage and optimize AWS storage services: EBS : Volume creation, performance tuning (GP3/IO2), snapshots, encryption S3 : Bucket management, lifecycle rules, replication, versioning EFS : Performance modes, throughput, mounting and integration FSx (Windows, ONTAP): Backup, snapshots, performance troubleshooting Monitor cost, utilization, and performance of AWS storage resources. Support hybrid storage integration with on-prem SAN and backup infrastructure. Azure Cloud Storage Skills Administer Azure storage resources such as: Azure Storage Accounts : Blobs, Files, Queues, Tables Azure Files : SMB/NFS shares, snapshots, backup policies Azure Managed Disks : Performance tuning, snapshots, encryption Azure Net App Files (ANF) : Volumes, pools, snapshots, replication Configure shared storage for Azure VMs and AKS workloads. Manage cloud storage security (RBAC, keys, private endpoints). Support storage monitoring and optimization through Azure Monitor. SAN Fabric Administration Manage and troubleshoot Brocade & Cisco MDS SAN fabrics. Responsibilities include zoning, VSAN configuration, ISL setup, RSCN troubleshooting, and performance diagnostics. Lead resolution of complex fabric-level incidents and outages. Data Protection (Commvault) – Level 2 Administer and maintain Commvault Comm Cell (Comm Serve, MAs, DDB, Libraries). Manage backup schedules, storage policies, retention settings, and job monitoring. Perform end-to-end restore operations (file, VM, database, application). Troubleshoot MA/DDB performance, agent failures, connectivity issues. Support cloud library backups (Azure Blob, AWS S3). Required Technical Skills On-Prem Storage (Advanced) Hitachi VSP/HCP Net App ONTAP HPE Nimble, Primera, 3PAR, MSA Dell EMC, Synology Cloud Storage (Intermediate–Advanced) AWS Storage: EBS, S3, EFS, FSx, Backup policies Azure Storage: ANF, Managed Disks, Storage Accounts, Azure Files SAN Switching (Expert Level) Brocade SAN Cisco MDS (NX-OS) ISLs, Zoning, Fabric merges, FC protocols Data Protection (Commvault – Level 2) Backup and restore administration Policy and SLA management Troubleshooting Media Agent, DDB, cloud libraries Application-aware backups Soft Skills Strong analytical ability and end-to-end troubleshooting capability. Excellent written and verbal communication. Leadership during severity incidents. Capable of guiding L1/L2 teams. Preferred Qualifications Certifications: Hitachi, Net App, Brocade, Cisco, AWS, Azure Commvault Certified Professional (CCP) ITIL Foundation Scripting knowledge (Power Shell/Python/CLI) Apply now Cloud Engineering-832000 Chennai, India Share on: Apply now Terms of service Privacy Cookies Powered by Rippling

title: Vmware NSX L3
jobDescription: Job Description Configure and optimize NSX components, including logical switches, rou... Job Description Configure and optimize NSX components, including logical switches, routers, firewalls, and load balancers. Resolve complex issues related to network virtualization, including performance, connectivity, and security problems. Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence of issues. Monitor and manage the NSX environment to ensure optimal performance and availability. Implement and manage policies for network segmentation, micro segmentation, and traffic management. Design and implement robust security measures within the NSX environment, including firewall rules, VPNs, and IDS/IPS configurations. Conduct regular security assessments and audits to ensure compliance with security policies and industry regulations. Lead the design and architecture of advanced network virtualization solutions using VMware NSX. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for network virtualization architectures, including diagrams and configurations. Oversee the deployment of NSX environments, ensuring they meet business requirements and industry best practices. Skills & Experiences Experience in network engineering with a focus on network virtualization using VMware NSX. Prior experience in a senior or lead role is highly desirable. In depth knowledge of VMware NSX and related technologies. Extensive experience with network virtualization concepts and technologies, including VXLAN, DFW, and NSXT Data Center. Relevant certifications such as VMware Certified Professional Network Virtualization (VCPNV), VMware Certified Advanced Professional Network Virtualization (VCAPNV), or VMware Certified Design Expert Network Virtualization (VCDXNV). Strong knowledge of network security principles and best practices within virtualized environments. Experience implementing and managing firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and other security technologies in NSX environments. Strong Knowledge in VMware NSX and related products (e.g., v Sphere, v Center). Knowledge Network management and monitoring tools (e.g., VMware v Realize Network Insight, Solar Winds,). Key Responsibilities Deployment and Configuration: Install, configure, and maintain VMware NSX clusters. Design and implement network virtualization solutions using NSX. Integrate NSX with existing infrastructure and other VMware products. Management and Monitoring: Monitor and manage NSX environments to ensure high availability and performance. Perform regular system audits and generate performance reports. Implement and maintain backup and disaster recovery solutions. Troubleshooting and Support: Diagnose and resolve issues related to NSX deployments. Provide technical support and guidance to other IT staff and end-users. Work with VMware and Dell EMC support for complex issue resolution. Security and Compliance: Ensure the security of the virtualized environment by implementing best practices and security policies. Conduct regular security assessments and vulnerability management. Ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations. Documentation and Training: Create and maintain detailed documentation for configurations, processes, and procedures. Train IT staff and end-users on the usage and best practices of NSX technologies. Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies through continuous learning. title: Engineer - DevOPs
jobDescription: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced AWS Dev Ops Engineer II with strong technical leadership, hands-on experience in AWS Dev Ops mindset. The ideal candidate will possess in-depth knowledge of AWS services, infrastructure automation, Kubernetes, along with demonstrated success in customer satisfaction and cloud deployment processes. We are looking for an Open Shift / Kubernetes Engineer with broad expertise in orchestrating, automating, and supporting cloud-native platforms and application ecosystems. You’ll ensure the reliability, availability, and security of modern software deployments by managing clusters, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, service discovery, and ITSM workflows . Responsibilities · Cloud Application Development: Develop, deploy, and manage cloud applications with a focus on scalability, performance, and security in AWS environments. · Dev Ops: Implement CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Git, Jenkins, and Terraform, ensuring smooth, automated deployments and infrastructure management. · Create and update runbooks, deployment checklists, SOPs, and operational documentation for applications and infrastructure. · Logging & Monitoring: Implement logging and monitoring using tools like Splunk and New Relic to maintain system health and performance. · Incident Management: Apply ITIL concepts in incident, change, and problem management to maintain service reliability and operational excellence. Open Shift / Kubernetes Cluster Operations · Cluster Management: Administer and tune clusters—manage nodes, pools, scheduling, resource quotas, and platform operators for smooth operations. · Ingress & Routing: Configure routes/ingress controllers to optimize traffic flow and security. Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution · Diagnose issues such as pod evictions, image pull errors, registry access, DNS and networking faults, and persistent storage challenges. Release Support & Deployment Patterns · Design and implement blue/green, canary, and rolling deployments for risk-managed releases. · Utilize feature flags and ensure rollback strategies for business continuity. Security & Compliance · Establish namespaces, RBAC, network policies, and manage secrets to enforce robust security practices and regulatory compliance. Secrets & Configuration Management · Administer Vault, KMS, and Config Maps for secrets and app configuration. Handle leases, renewals, encryption, and rotation. · Monitor and audit access logs, approvals, and enforce dual-control procedures. API & Messaging Operations · Operate API Gateways (NGINX), Kafka, MQ—configure routing, rate limiting, back-pressure, consumer lag, and DLQ management. · Troubleshoot schemas, contracts, timeouts, retries, and ensure idempotent processing. · Manage backward-compatible deployments, versioning, and traffic shaping. Qualifications · Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). · 7+ years of experience in software engineering, including 4+ years with AWS. · Strong knowledge of Dev Ops practices, pipelines, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation. · Strong scripting/automation skills (Python, Bash, Go, etc.). · 2 years of experience in AWS Cloud Architecture, Networking, and Security. · Experience with infrastructure as code and policy as code tools. · Good troubleshooting and documentation skills. · Strong communication and teamwork abilities. · Familiarity with agile methodologies and tools such as Jira and Confluence. · ITIL and Agile knowledge for managing incidents and change requests. Certifications · AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or AWS Certified Dev Ops Engineer – Professional. · Relevant certifications (CKA, CKAD, Open Shift) or open-source contributions. Preferred Skills · Experience with cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), hybrid or multi-cloud architectures. · Familiarity with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) and regulated environments (PCI, SOC2, HIPAA).
